item.title: Keepy - Your Receipts Management. Simplified.
item.description:
Keepy: Simplifying Receipt Management

Keepy is a user-friendly solution designed to streamline your receipt management process. With Keepy, you can easily submit, store, and organize your receipts, making expense tracking and financial management a breeze.

Key Features

  • Effortless Data Entry: Simply email your receipts to keep@keepy.us, and let our AI handle the rest.
  • Reliable Automation: Our AI works 24/7 to process your data entry tasks accurately.
  • Human-Assisted Accuracy: In case of any AI challenges, our human agents ensure precise results.
  • Seamless Integration: Keepy integrates smoothly with your existing systems and workflows.

How It Works

Receipt Management Workflow

  1. Obtain a Receipt: Ensure you have a receipt for the expense you want to keep.

  2. Submit the Receipt: You can send the receipt through multiple channels:

    • Email: Send the receipt to keep@keepy.us
    • SMS: Text the receipt to 650-417-3562‬
    • Messenger: Send the receipt via m.me/keepy.us

  3. Data Entry and Storage: Once submitted, your receipt will be entered and stored in a Google Sheet for easy access and management.

Keepy supports a variety of file formats to accommodate different types of receipts:

  • PDF
  • PNG
  • HEIC
